title: Anesthetics isoflurane and sevoflurane attenuate flagellin-mediated inflammation in the lung.
authors: Yuki, Koichi; Mitsui, Yusuke; Shibamura-Fujiogi, Miho; Hou, Lifei; Odegard, Kirsten C; Soriano, Sulpicio G; Priebe, Gregory P; Koutsogiannaki, Sophia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究麻醉剂对TLR5-鞭毛蛋白介导炎症的调节作用，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Isoflurane and sevoflurane are volatile anesthetics (VA) widely used in clinical practice to provide general anesthesia. We and others have previously shown that VAs have immunomodulatory effects and may have a significant impact on the progression of disease states. Flagellin is a component of Gram negative bacteria and plays a significant role in the pathophysiology of bacterial pneumonia through its binding to Toll-like Receptor 5 (TLR5). Our results showed that VAs, not an intravenous anesthetic, significantly attenuated the activation of TLR5 and the release of the neutrophil chemoattractant IL-8 from lung epithelial cells. Furthermore, flagellin-induced lung injury was significantly attenuated by VAs by inhibiting neutrophil migration to the bronchoalveolar space. The lungs of cystic fibrosis (CF) patients are highly colonized by Pseudomonas aeruginosa, which causes inflammation. The retrospective study of oxygenation in patients with CF who had received VA versus intravenous anesthesia suggested that VAs might have the protective effect for gas exchange. To understand the interaction between VAs and TLR5, a docking simulation was performed, which indicated that isoflurane and sevoflurane docked into the binding interphase between TLR5 and flagellin.
abstract_zh: 异氟烷和七氟烷是临床上广泛用于全身麻醉的挥发性麻醉药（VA）。我们及他人此前已表明，VA具有免疫调节作用，并可能对疾病状态的进展产生显著影响。鞭毛蛋白是革兰氏阴性菌的一种成分，通过其与Toll样受体5（TLR5）的结合，在细菌性肺炎的病理生理学中发挥重要作用。我们的结果表明，VA（而非静脉麻醉药）显著减弱了TLR5的激活以及肺上皮细胞释放中性粒细胞趋化因子IL-8。此外，VA通过抑制中性粒细胞向支气管肺泡空间的迁移，显著减轻了鞭毛蛋白诱导的肺损伤。囊性纤维化（CF）患者的肺部高度定植有铜绿假单胞菌，这会引起炎症。对接受VA与静脉麻醉的CF患者氧合情况的回顾性研究表明，VA可能对气体交换具有保护作用。为理解VA与TLR5之间的相互作用，进行了对接模拟，结果表明异氟烷和七氟烷对接入TLR5与鞭毛蛋白之间的结合界面。
